name: GWS Tool Group
notes: gwstoolgroup.com describes a B2B manufacturer of industrial cutting tools (end mills and similar), not a retailer of drills. Buzzfile and Glassdoor listings place a GWS Tool facility at 739 Fesslers Ln (the listings give ZIP 37210, not 37224), and the distance is consistent with the other Nashville rows.

name: Fox equipment
notes: The HTTPS page failed with a TLS error ('unable to verify the first certificate'). http://www.foxequipment.net/ shows a construction equipment rental company at 5200 Highway 33/34, Farmingdale, NJ. The Vernalis CA-33 address looks like a mis-geocode of the NJ highway, and there are no headlamps (it rents light towers and generators).

name: Manteca Sportsmen Inc
notes: The site returned an expired-certificate error. thecmp.org/cmp-clubs/manteca-sportsmen-inc/ and Yelp describe a nonprofit shooting club and range at 30261 S Airport Way. It appears on an FFL dealer list, but I found no evidence of a retail shop selling headlamps.

name: Nautical power marine
notes: The listed domain does not resolve (DNS error). A related site, nauticalpowermarine.us.com, sells marine inboard engines and generators; it gives '2207 CA-33' with no city, an Indiana-area phone number, and says it ships from the USA and Portugal. There are no headlamps, and nothing confirms a physical shop in Vernalis.

name: Triple J Armory Retail Shop and Indoor Shooting Range
notes: triplejarmory.com confirms a firearms shop and range at 8152 Southpark Ln. Its shop page (triplejarmory.com/shop/) lists only apparel, stickers, memberships and gift cards, with no drinkware. The OSM geocode of the address is about 3 mi from central Littleton, against the 1.4 mi shown.

name: Uni Uni Bubble Tea Lincoln Park
notes: DoorDash and order.online both returned 403. The Yelp, Grubhub and Seamless listings confirm a bubble tea shop at 2550 N Clark St, and uniuni.us describes only prepared drinks, with no retail loose-leaf tea. The address is about 3.6 mi from the Loop, so 0.7 mi fits only if the site centers Chicago on the north side.

name: Breed & Co Ace Hardware
notes: The Ace store page confirms 718 W 29th St and lists a Housewares department. Breed & Co's own shop (breed.myshoplocal.com, category 'Pour Over & French Press') and acehardware.com product pages (Bodum, Fellow Stagg XF and YETI pour-over brewers) show drippers are sold.

name: Prufrock’s
notes: The UT Housing page describes a Starbucks-beverage café in the Perry-Castañeda Library (101 E 21st St, next to Speedway) serving drinks and grab-and-go food. It mentions no retail brewing equipment.

name: YETI
notes: The store page returned 403. Yelp (updated Sept 2026) and austintexas.org confirm the flagship at 220 S Congress Ave. YETI's own site sells the Rambler Pour Over dripper (yeti.com/drinkware/mugs/pour-over.html), but in-store stock at this location is not confirmed.

name: GadgetWise
notes: The mixo.io page returns 404 and gadgetwise.net does not resolve. Yelp (last updated Oct 2024) and loc8nearme list a phone and computer repair service at 1719 N Mannheim Rd with no retail batteries mentioned, and I found no current listing confirming it is still open.

name: Antique Archaeology Nashville
notes: The Nashville store closed on April 27, 2025 (fox17.com, wqad.com, and Yelp marks it CLOSED). antiquearchaeology.com lists only the LeClaire, IA store and sells antiques and merchandise, with no wooden train sets seen.

name: Game Point - A Game Store
notes: gamepointcafe.com/game-point-the-retail-expansion/ and bongojava.com/pages/game-point-retail confirm a board game retail store at 1804 21st Ave S. Neither mentions toys or wooden trains.

name: Hard Rock Cafe Gift Shop
notes: The URL is a gift-card page. nashvilledowntown.com and Yelp describe the Rock Shop at 100 Broadway as selling T-shirts, pins, key chains and posters, with no toys.

name: Vanderbilt Medical Center Gift Shop
notes: The page lists the adult hospital gift shop (Vanderbilt merchandise, stuffed animals, electronics accessories, clothing) with no toys beyond stuffed animals. The separate Children's Hospital Friends Shop sells generic toys, but no wooden trains are mentioned.

name: Royal Textile Products Co
notes: The URL redirects to royaltextileproducts.com, which shows a custom window-covering and shade business at 1330 Zuni St Suite A-E. It sells no blankets.

name: Sewn Denver
notes: sewndenver.com confirms 18 S Broadway and sells handmade clothing, vintage fabric and 'sewn goods' by local makers. Neither the home page nor the makers page mentions blankets.

name: St. John Knits Boutique
notes: stjohnknits.com sells women's knitwear (jackets, dresses, sweaters, accessories) and no blankets or home goods. The Cherry Creek North directory (cherrycreeknorth.com/go/st-john-knits) lists the boutique at 224 Steele St.

name: Tattered Cover Union Station
notes: tatteredcover.com lists the Union Station store at 1701 Wynkoop St. Its product page for the 'Colorful Book Throw Blanket' (tatteredcover.com/products/0059283881509) shows it in stock at Union Station, but the material is not stated, so it is a blanket rather than a confirmed wool one.

name: Specialized Atlanta
notes: The store page returned 403. thekrogdistrict.com/specialized and Yelp confirm the store at 112 Krog St NE Ste 10, and its old domain specializedatlanta.bike redirects to specialized.com, which sells merino wool socks (e.g. specialized.com/us/en/merino-midweight-tall-socks/p/200487). In-store stock is not confirmed, and the map category 'car rental' is wrong.
